description: Validates the 'User Guide — Getting Started' knowledgebase tutorial by executing each step via Obsidian commands and EventBus events, capturing screenshots at every step.

steps.title: Open the User Hub
steps.description: Opens the User Hub via the command palette. This is the central dashboard for user-facing features.
steps.expectedOutput: flowti-user-hub leaf is active in the center pane

actions.label: user-hub
actions.description: User Hub open with Sessions tab

steps.title: Open the Event Catalog
steps.description: Opens the Event Catalog to explore and describe the business domain. Lists all event definitions and domain categories.

actions.label: event-catalog
actions.description: Event Catalog open with Domains tab

steps.title: Navigate to Domains tab
steps.description: Switches the Event Catalog to the Domains tab to view domain groupings and categories.
steps.expectedOutput: Domains tab is active, showing domain list

actions.label: domains-tab
actions.description: Domains tab active in Event Catalog

steps.title: Open the Data Exchange Hub
steps.description: Opens the Data Exchange Hub where import/export configurations and data pipeline status are managed.

actions.description: Data Exchange Hub leaf is open

actions.label: data-exchange-hub
actions.description: Data Exchange Hub open with Pipelines tab

steps.title: Verify test data for import
steps.description: Confirms the generated Suppliers.csv test data is present in the vault and indexed by Obsidian.
steps.expectedInput: CSV generated by generate-test-data.mjs at 03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv
steps.expectedOutput: File is indexed in vault (getAbstractFileByPath returns truthy)

actions.code: (() => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv'); if (!f) throw new Error('Test data CSV not found: 03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv'); return 'true'; })()

(() => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv'); if (f) app.internalPlugins.plugins['file-explorer']?.instance?.revealInFolder(f); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Reveal test data CSV in file explorer

actions.label: test-data
actions.description: Test data CSV revealed in file explorer

steps.title: Open CSV Import view
steps.description: Triggers the CSV import flow by emitting ui.openCsvImport with the Suppliers.csv path. The Data Exchange Hub must be open for the import callback to be registered.
steps.expectedInput: Data Exchange Hub open, Suppliers CSV at 03 - Resources/Test Data/Analytics/Suppliers.csv
steps.expectedOutput: CSV import action view opens with file preview
interactions: emit: Open CSV import with file path

actions.label: csv-import
actions.description: CSV import view open with file preview

steps.title: Navigate to Properties tab
steps.description: Switches the Data Exchange Hub to the Properties tab to inspect data exchange configuration and field mappings.
steps.expectedInput: Data Exchange Hub view is open
steps.expectedOutput: Properties tab is active, showing configuration details

actions.label: properties-tab
actions.description: Properties tab active in Data Exchange Hub

steps.title: Open the Analytics Hub
steps.description: Opens the Analytics Hub for dashboard creation and CSV-based data analysis.

actions.label: analytics-hub
actions.description: Analytics Hub open with Dashboards tab
